items.title: Alcide "Slow Drag" Pavageau and Lawrence Marrero Interview, 1957-09-01
items.q: He was a professor with Mineta... Me, Mineta, and Udel... And then we had this guy Montoya playing trumpet with us. That's years ago.

ctx.x: any song you want. Yeah. You're playing with a band though, you might be off key when you're using these keys.

Oh well now, when a band, sometimes I play, it all depends. Now if the band plays a piece in C, of course you can play the old soul. But now if you change the keys on you, well then you have to change keys too. Yeah. Now if you play, if you've been playing F, you gotta throw F, then it's just D. G7, C7, then F. If you play in Bb, then you're playing, then G7. Then it makes C7, F7, then Bb. You play in Eb. Now if you play in Eb. Now if you play in Eb. G7, C7, then F. Bb7, then Eb. You play in Eb. You play in Eb.…
